convert_s3prl_checkpoint: convert an S3PRL wav2vec2 checkpoint to a HuggingFace PyTorch model
convert_classification: convert S3PRL downstream classification weights to a HuggingFace Wav2Vec2ForSequenceClassification model
convert_diarization: convert S3PRL diarization weights to a HuggingFace Wav2Vec2ForAudioFrameClassification model
convert_xvector: convert S3PRL xvector extraction weights to a HuggingFace Wav2Vec2ForXVector model
run_cli_convert: run the CLI script to convert S3PRL wav2vec2 checkpoints to HuggingFace format
